chapter: Buffalo, Lunceford, Lil Armstrong and Stuff Smith
title: Sorting out dates: leaving the Vendome in 1931 when Willie Bryant came in
summary: Jones clarifies that he left the Vendome after about a year when the owner brought in Willie Bryant's big band, in 1931 before the Savoy job of 1932.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: And in the meantime, during this time, in '31, I left -- I left and went with Lunceford then.
Now, wait a minute. Now, wait a minute. How can this be? You were telling me a little while ago that somebody sent for you and you went to the Savoy.

Yeah, well this is '32. '32 was when I went there. But around about '31, when the band -- when we went out of the Vendome, and what they did they brought in -- the guy decided to bring in a band like Willy Bryant. Willy had Teddy Wilson, Benny Carter, you know, and they decided to bring in this band, a big band from out of town.
You know. So we went out, after about a year there.
